description: Given a Control id, list third-party vendors and in-house approaches that may implement it, with effort/cost signals and a source-disclosure (editorial research vs vendor submission). Magist does not accept payment from vendors and does not rank or endorse them. Returns a neutral catalog for research; evaluate fit independently.

jurisdiction.description: Optional market/region filter, e.g. "eu". Applied only when a vendor declares supported regions.

name: find_vendors
title: Find implementation vendors
